Canonical Rippling Payroll / HRIS model built from normalized Rippling REST API shared-resource tables. Source API JSON is recursively normalized by CommonWSDataset into SR parent/child tables, then _MDD_JCT_RIPPLING.SQL composes employees, organization structures, contact media, pay periods, time punches, segments, supervisory relationships, and RLS support outputs. Field semantics use SQL/code and the supplied SR discovery pack as structural evidence, with official Rippling REST API documentation used for source-field meaning where available.
